name: Get live updates token
description: Call this when you need to obtain a token for receiving live updates in analytics or automation dashboards. If the user does not have any active integrations, the response will contain an error; in that case, use the action to configure or activate an integration instead.
preconditions: The user must have at least one active integration.

error.description: Error message when no active integrations are present.

token.description: A JWT or similar token used for live update connections.
